title: Vendor API — Cost / Spend
description: Per-vendor and per-endpoint cost in paise and INR. Sourced from ClickHouse cost_paise column. Wired from day one per HLD A3.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(cost_paise) / 100.0 AS total_inr FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE toDate(created_at) = today() AND cost_paise IS NOT NULL
SELECT sum(cost_paise) / 100.0 AS total_inr FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE toStartOfMonth(created_at) = toStartOfMonth(today()) AND cost_paise IS NOT NULL

SELECT toDate(created_at) AS day, vendor_id, sum(cost_paise) / 100.0 AS spend_inr FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE created_at >= today() - 30 AND cost_paise IS NOT NULL GROUP BY day, vendor_id ORDER BY day, vendor_id

SELECT vendor_id, endpoint, count() AS calls, sum(cost_paise) AS total_paise, round(sum(cost_paise) / 100.0, 2) AS total_inr, round(avg(cost_paise), 2) AS avg_paise_per_call FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND cost_paise IS NOT NULL GROUP BY vendor_id, endpoint ORDER BY total_paise DESC

SELECT toStartOfHour(created_at) AS hour, vendor_id, sum(cost_paise) / 100.0 AS spend_inr FROM vendor_archive.vendor_api_events WHERE created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 48 HOUR AND cost_paise IS NOT NULL GROUP BY hour, vendor_id ORDER BY hour
